This is a senior backend engineering role (5+ years) at Engenious, building AI-driven product features and high-load backend services. The work centers on designing scalable APIs and microservices, integrating LLM-based functionality into product workflows, and operating WebSocket-based real-time systems at scale. The core stack is Java and Spring Boot with Python alongside it, plus REST and GraphQL APIs and message brokers like Kafka and RabbitMQ.
